title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Configure the default calculation for the Calculate Consumption report (Default Consumption Calculation Based on)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces a new Default Consumption Calculation Based on field in Manufacturing Setup that lets users specify whether the Calculate Consumption report should default to expected or actual output, saving time by eliminating manual changes for each consumption calculation.
key_points: Manufacturing Setup now has a Default Consumption Calculation Based on field to configure default consumption calculation behavior
Users can choose between Expected Output or Actual Output as the default calculation basis
The default selection applies to the Calculate Consumption report and production journal consumption line calculations
The field defaults the report but users can override the selection when needed
features: Default Consumption Calculation Based on field

quotes.text: set the default consumption calculation in Manufacturing Setup so the Calculate Consumption report matches your preferred process automatically
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary business value of automating report defaults to save time and reduce manual effort

quotes.text: Whether the calculation of the quantity to consume is based on the actual output or on the expected output
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the two calculation options available for users to configure based on their operational needs
